questions.stem: Select all cells present in Proper Connective Tissue matrix:
questions.explanation: Proper CT matrix contains fibroblasts, mast cells, histocytes, plasma cells.

questions.stem: Which glands release secretion via Exocytosis or Apical Pinching without total cell destruction? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Merocrine (salivary) exocytoses; Apocrine pinches apex; Holocrine ruptures whole cell.

questions.stem: Select all features true for Mammalian Erythrocytes:
questions.explanation: Mammalian RBCs lack nuclei/mitochondria, undergo anaerobic respiration, live 120 days.

questions.stem: Which of the following structures contain Hyaline Cartilage? (Select all that apply)
options: A) Articular ends of long bones
answers: A) Articular ends of long bones
questions.explanation: Hyaline cartilage lines articular ends, nasal septum, ribs, trachea. Intervertebral discs = fibrocartilage.

questions.stem: Select all Granulocytic Leucocytes found in human blood:
questions.explanation: Granulocytes = Neutro, Eosino, Baso; Agranulocytes = Lympho, Mono.

questions.stem: [MSQ_msq_prep_medium] Which locations feature Pseudostratified Ciliated Columnar Epithelium? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Pseudostratified lines trachea, bronchi, nasopharynx. Oviduct = simple ciliated columnar.

questions.stem: Select all connective tissue sheaths found in skeletal muscle architecture:
Which statements correctly describe Cartilage matrix (Chondrin)? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Cartilage matrix is solid, pliable, resists compression, avascular, secreted by chondroblasts.

questions.stem: Select all leucocytes capable of amoeboid phagocytosis: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Neutrophils and Monocytes/Macrophages are active phagocytic leucocytes.

questions.stem: Which structures are present in a typical Multipolar Neurone? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Multipolar neurones have 1 cyton, multiple dendrites, 1 axon, Nissl's granules.
